topics.title: NEAR Intents and Its Solver Market
topics.angleHint: How NEAR Intents turns a user's desired outcome into competing solver quotes settled by an on-chain verifier.

facts.text: In NEAR Intents, an intent expresses what a user wants to achieve rather than how to achieve it.
facts.supportingQuote: An intent expresses what you want to achieve, not how to get it.

facts.text: NEAR Intents sends quote requests to solvers over the Message Bus, a WebSocket relay that broadcasts each request to all connected solvers.
facts.supportingQuote: A user sends a quote request to the Message Bus, a WebSocket relay that broadcasts the request to all connected solvers.

facts.text: Once a user accepts a quote, the intent is executed by calling the Verifier smart contract on NEAR Protocol.
facts.supportingQuote: the intent is executed by calling a "Verifier" smart contract on NEAR Protocol.

facts.text: If an intent cannot be fulfilled, the transaction is reverted and funds are returned to the refund address.
facts.supportingQuote: Transactions either complete with all conditions met, or they are reverted and funds returned to the refund address.

facts.text: When a user signs with an existing wallet, the Verifier derives an account from their public key, removing the need to create a NEAR account.
facts.supportingQuote: When a user signs with their existing wallet, the Verifier derives an account from their public key.

topics.title: NEAR AI Cloud's Confidential Inference
topics.angleHint: NEAR AI Cloud runs models inside hardware enclaves and publishes attestations users can verify.

facts.text: NEAR AI Cloud combines Intel TDX and NVIDIA TEE technologies to create isolated, secure environments for AI computation.
facts.supportingQuote: NEAR AI Cloud combines Intel TDX and NVIDIA TEE technologies to create isolated, secure environments for AI computation

facts.text: NEAR AI Cloud states that infrastructure providers, model providers, and NEAR itself cannot access user data at any point in the process.
facts.supportingQuote: Infrastructure providers, model providers, and NEAR cannot access your data at any point in the process.

facts.text: Every TEE environment used by NEAR AI Cloud generates cryptographic proofs that verify the integrity of the execution environment.
facts.supportingQuote: Every TEE environment generates cryptographic proofs that verify the integrity of the execution environment

facts.text: NEAR AI Cloud exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, which its documentation says makes integration with existing tools and libraries easy.
facts.supportingQuote: NEAR AI Cloud uses an OpenAI-compatible API, making it easy to integrate with existing tools and libraries.

facts.text: NEAR AI Cloud's documentation lists a Confidential TEE tier whose models run on NEAR AI's own GPU fleet inside Trusted Execution Environments.
facts.supportingQuote: models run on NEAR AI's own GPU fleet inside Trusted Execution Environments

topics.title: AI Agents and Tool Use
topics.angleHint: How agentic systems differ from fixed workflows, and how open protocols standardize tool access.

facts.text: Anthropic defines workflows as systems where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths.
facts.supportingQuote: Workflows are systems where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths.

facts.text: By contrast, Anthropic defines agents as systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage.
facts.supportingQuote: Agents, on the other hand, are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage

facts.text: The Model Context Protocol is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems, including data sources and tools.
facts.sourceTitle: What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?
facts.supportingQuote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems.

facts.text: ReAct is a prompting approach that has language models generate reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner.
facts.sourceTitle: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
facts.supportingQuote: generate both reasoning traces and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner

facts.text: The ReAct paper reports that the method outperformed imitation and reinforcement learning baselines by 34 percentage points on ALFWorld and 10 on WebShop.
facts.sourceTitle: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
facts.supportingQuote: ReAct outperforms imitation and reinforcement learning methods by an absolute success rate of 34% and 10% respectively

topics.title: Small and Open-Weight Models
topics.angleHint: Compact and open-weight models are narrowing the capability gap while fitting on phones and small deployments.

facts.text: Microsoft's April 2024 Phi-3 technical report introduces phi-3-mini, a 3.8 billion parameter model trained on 3.3 trillion tokens.
facts.sourceTitle: Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone
facts.supportingQuote: We introduce phi-3-mini, a 3.8 billion parameter language model trained on 3.3 trillion tokens

facts.text: The Phi-3 technical report says phi-3-mini is small enough to be deployed on a phone.
facts.sourceTitle: Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone
facts.supportingQuote: small enough to be deployed on a phone

facts.text: Phi-3-mini achieves 69 percent on MMLU and 8.38 on MT-bench, according to the April 2024 technical report.
facts.sourceTitle: Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone
facts.supportingQuote: phi-3-mini achieves 69% on MMLU and 8.38 on MT-bench

facts.text: The July 2024 Llama 3 paper reports that Llama 3 delivers comparable quality to leading language models such as GPT-4 on a plethora of tasks.
facts.supportingQuote: We find that Llama 3 delivers comparable quality to leading language models such as GPT-4 on a plethora of tasks.

facts.text: Google's 2024 Gemma 2 technical report states that the models offer competitive alternatives to models two to three times bigger.
facts.sourceTitle: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
facts.supportingQuote: competitive alternatives to models that are 2-3 times bigger.

topics.title: Stablecoins as Payment Rails
topics.angleHint: What stablecoins promise for payments, how U.S. rules require backing, and where the BIS sees structural flaws.

facts.text: The St. Louis Fed defines a payment stablecoin as a digital asset issued on a public blockchain for payment and settlement purposes.
facts.sourceTitle: Regulated Payment Stablecoins Become a Reality in the U.S.
facts.supportingQuote: a digital asset issued on a public blockchain designed for payment and settlement purposes.

facts.text: Under the U.S. GENIUS Act, issuers are required to hold reserves on at least a one-to-one basis against the value of coins issued.
facts.sourceTitle: Regulated Payment Stablecoins Become a Reality in the U.S.
facts.supportingQuote: Issuers are required to hold assets (reserves) on at least a one-to-one basis against the value of the coins issued.

facts.text: Authorized issuers of payment stablecoins are required to redeem them for a fixed amount of money.
facts.sourceTitle: Regulated Payment Stablecoins Become a Reality in the U.S.
facts.supportingQuote: Authorized issuers of payment stablecoins are required to redeem them for a fixed amount of money

facts.text: The BIS concluded in June 2026 that stablecoins in their current form fall short on key properties of money and have structural flaws.
facts.sourceTitle: The path to the next-generation monetary and financial system lies in safeguarding trust in money
facts.supportingQuote: Their current form, however, falls short on key properties of money and has structural flaws.

facts.text: The BIS defines singleness as the ability to redeem different forms of money exactly at par in exchange for central bank money.
facts.sourceTitle: The path to the next-generation monetary and financial system lies in safeguarding trust in money
facts.supportingQuote: singleness, or the ability to redeem different forms of money exactly at par in exchange for central bank money

topics.title: Tokenized Settlement: Project Agorá
topics.angleHint: A BIS-led experiment tests tokenized central bank reserves and commercial bank deposits on a shared platform.

facts.text: Project Agorá is a BIS public-private collaboration testing a multi-currency shared programmable platform for wholesale cross-border payments.
facts.supportingQuote: multi-currency shared programmable platform for wholesale cross-border payments.

facts.text: Project Agorá examines whether tokenisation of wholesale central bank money and commercial bank deposits on programmable platforms can improve the monetary system.
facts.sourceTitle: Project Agorá: central banks and banking sector embark on major project to explore tokenisation of cross-border payments
facts.supportingQuote: tokenisation of wholesale central bank money and commercial bank deposits on programmable platforms can improve the monetary system.

facts.text: In April 2024, the BIS and seven central banks announced Project Agorá to explore tokenisation of cross-border payments.
facts.sourceTitle: Project Agorá: central banks and banking sector embark on major project to explore tokenisation of cross-border payments
facts.supportingQuote: The Bank for International Settlements (BIS) together with seven central banks

facts.text: Twenty-eight financial institutions and central banks across Asia, Europe, and North America took part in Project Agorá's July 2026 real-value testing.
facts.supportingQuote: Twenty-eight financial institutions and central banks across Asia, Europe and North America

facts.text: Project Agorá's July 2026 real-value testing recorded an average time from payment initiation to settlement of approximately 80 seconds.
facts.supportingQuote: the average time from payment initiation to settlement was approximately 80 seconds.
